claims.text: US Patent 1,974,483, 'ELECTROSTATIC MOTOR', names Thomas Townsend Brown of Zanesville, Ohio, filed 7 February 1930 (Ser. No. 426,738) and issued 25 September 1934.

The 1934 patent claims 'a method of producing force or motion by applying and maintaining high potential electro-static charges in a system of chargeable masses and associated electrodes', and describes the motor as useful in observatory recording instruments. It does not claim gravity control.
